semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides integrated circuit testing services and solutions specifically for semiconductor applications.
summary: Silicon Exceed Technology (JiangSu) Co., Ltd. specializes in integrated circuit testing services and testing system solutions for various chip categories. With capabilities in wafer testing, finished product testing, and burn-in testing, the company serves independent third-party clients and has developed solutions for AI, GPU, RF, and more.

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Zhenjiang, Jiangsu Province, with additional facilities in Tianjin and Shanghai.
